source.quote: iFi audio's own product page for the uno, read 2026-11-24: « True Native® playback. It handles PCM data to 32-bit/384kHz, DSD up to DSD256 and single and double speed DXD. »

_true_native_not_carried_over: « True Native® » IS USED HERE AND NOT EXPLAINED. iFi applies the trademark across its range; only the ZEN DAC 3's page spells out what it means - « PCM and DSD take separate pathways - this enables DSD... to remain 'bit-perfect' in its native form right through to analogue conversion ». So dsd_direct is NOT asserted on this record: carrying a meaning from one page to another because the same trade mark appears is the range-cited-for-one-model error, and this catalogue calls that its most common. What the term licenses at brand level is asserted once, on database/brands/ifi.json, with that sentence as its evidence.
